observed_defect: Flat prairie ground lacks visible strategic elevation variation from camera perspective
design_intent: Create broad asymmetric rolling hills and valleys to enhance visual depth and strategic terrain awareness without altering city boundaries or moving protected vertices
expected_visual_difference: Visible elevation changes in terrain silhouette from camera, no vertex displacement, no material change

actions.reason: Create a broad, asymmetric hill centered at (x=20, y=55, z=0) with radius 35m and delta z=+5m to establish a visible strategic hill in the upper right quadrant
Create a complementary valley centered at (x=-40, y=45, z=0) with radius 30m and delta z=-3m to form a natural saddle, enhancing visual depth and terrain flow
